question: does law in force BEFORE the moment of choice FORBID a threshold that loosens as evidence accumulates — or, more precisely, does it exclude dispersion-of-dispersion from the legal candidate set?
finding: YES — excluded, and on DEFINITIONAL grounds, not directional
in_force_at_moment_of_choice: YES — three days earlier, by date, not recollection
sentences_quoted_not_paraphrased: It is such a measurement only if the absolute margin between reading and threshold EXCEEDS the replicate spread of that same statistic under the same instrument, measured across the instrument's declared seed ensemble.
A spread of a DIFFERENT statistic is not a spread.
The response is to increase resolving power and re-measure — never to move the threshold, never to pick the side that suits, never to commit and challenge afterward.
forbids_or_merely_licenses: FORBIDS. 'A spread of a DIFFERENT statistic is not a spread' is a definitional exclusion stated flatly — it removes a candidate from the legal set rather than licensing one direction and staying silent on the other. It is not the converse of a licence
why_dispersion_of_dispersion_falls_under: 1i's comparator is the replicate spread of THE STATISTIC BEING COMPARED — set by its own first sentence, 'Every comparison of a measured statistic against a threshold', so the statistic is the reading and the floor is the threshold. Dispersion-of-dispersion (0.01866) is the spread BETWEEN two measurements of the max_seed_only_effect — i.e. the replicate spread of the PROXY statistic, not of the clearing. It is therefore a spread of a different statistic, which 1i says is not a spread
independent_of_A203: this exclusion rests on 1i's definition of the comparator and makes no appeal to the direction of movement, so it is not the reasoning A212 barred. A203's directional argument is not used
1k_corroborates: 1k (723acb4, 2026-08-08) names, for a cross-family clearing, 'the clearing itself recomputed at each seed of the declared ensemble, and its dispersion' as the named quantity, and max_seed_only_effect as 'a legitimate conservative proxy, not the test' — confirming that the compared statistic is the clearing, not the floor
residual_brought_not_resolved: one alternative reading exists and is stated rather than argued away: if 'that same statistic' were read as the THRESHOLD quantity rather than the reading, then dispersion-of-dispersion would be its replicate spread and would qualify. I judge that reading foreclosed by 1i's own first sentence and by 1k, but the owner asked for ambiguity to be brought rather than resolved, so it is named here
consequence: the legal candidate set at the moment of choice had TWO members (worst 0.16569, latest 0.14703); both yield FAIL on all three verdicts; the post-hoc choice is ADMISSIBLE under A205 as amended by A216
